_comment_intent: Single source of truth: REFACTOR-MCP.md §6.1 + PROTOCOLS.md §1.3 + §3.1. Both A2A skills (Path A) and MCP tool surfaces (Path B) are declared so one image lists into the Marketplace under either category. KR-gap disclosure section per docs/KR-GAP-DISCLOSURE.md.
name: Influencer Research Agent (TikTok)
description: Given a brand brief, finds and ranks TikTok creators by engagement and brief-fit. Powered by Social Seeding's public-data TikTok pipeline (RapidAPI-mediated; no TikTok Research API). Returns a structured top-10 with reasoning, engagement-rate, and source attribution.

extensions.description: AP2 Intent Mandate (D27) — declared as optional; the v1 surface accepts but does not yet require AP2.

oidc._comment: Identity Platform tenant OIDC discovery (D19). PROJECT_ID is substituted at deploy time by terraform/cloud-run-service.yaml.

skills.name: Plan and rank TikTok creators
skills.description: Plans queries, sources candidates across language variants, fetches engagement metrics, and returns a ranked top-10 with reasoning. Honors the per-tool daily quotas declared in the linked MCP server.
examples: Find 10 vegan-skincare TikTok creators in Korea for a Gen-Z launch.
Source US fitness creators 50k-200k followers with >5% engagement.
Identify Japanese beauty creators discussing fragrance-free skincare.

mcp_tools.name: tiktok_search
mcp_tools.description: Discover TikTok creators by keyword. 200 calls/day on the free tier.

mcp_tools.name: tiktok_user_info
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a creator's profile (followers, bio, video_count). 200 calls/day on the free tier.

mcp_tools.name: tiktok_user_posts
mcp_tools.description: Fetch a creator's recent posts with engagement metrics. 50 calls/day on the free tier.

mcp_tools.name: tiktok_post_detail
mcp_tools.description: Fetch detailed engagement for one post. 50 calls/day on the free tier.

_kr_gap_disclosure._comment: Per docs/KR-GAP-DISCLOSURE.md — the Korean entity behind this card cannot list as a paid Marketplace vendor as of 2026-05-19 because Korea is not on the 20-region payment whitelist. This card is published under the A2A-only distribution pattern documented at github.com/SocialSeeding/a2a-only-pattern.
